query:
WITH RECURSIVE tree AS (
                SELECT f.id, 0 AS down
                FROM knowledge_folders f
                WHERE f.id = $1 AND f.org_id = $2
                UNION ALL
                SELECT f.id, t.down + 1
                FROM knowledge_folders f
                JOIN tree t ON f.parent_id = t.id
                WHERE t.down < 64
            )
            SELECT COALESCE(MAX(down), 0) AS "height!" FROM tree
